Fix `plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 126): The component's two error paths have no tests. Nothing checks that a rejected updateNotifications posts the 'Failed to mark notification as read' danger toast without refetching (UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx:105-110). Nothing checks that a rejected getNotifications renders the 'Failed to load unread notifications' ErrorPanel (lines 114-120). change_plan.md's U12 test list leaves both out, so this is a gap in coverage, not a departure from the spec. — fix: Add one test where updateNotifications rejects: assert that toast post was called with the markAsReadFailed title and status 'danger', and that getNotifications was called only once. Add a second test, or extend an existing one, where getNotifications rejects and findByText('Failed to load unread notifications') resolves.
2. minor (line 181): The signal mock types its callback parameters as `any` ((message: any) => void at lines 181 and 184) when a precise type exists. — fix: Type the message parameter as NotificationSignal from '@backstage/plugin-notifications-common', or as JsonObject, instead of any.

Fix `plugins/home-react/src/extensions.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 44): The test is named 'shows the loading fallback and then lazy content', but it never checks that a fallback appeared. It only checks the title and the lazy content. Because of that, the fallback branch of the new hook (the core-components Progress returned when there is no app context) is never observed. — fix: Rename the test to something like 'renders lazy content without an app context'. Asserting the delayed Progress would need a test id or fake timers, so a rename is enough.
